Description
This pure gold bar is minted by MKS PAMP in Switzerland and showcases an Art Deco style design interpretation of the Lady of Justice which is that of truth, fairness and enforcement. These sentiments are symbolized by the Lady of Justice’s scales weighing evidence, her blindfold representing impartiality and her sword wielding the power of the law. This bar is individually serialized and housed in a CertiPAMP™ assay card.
Each one of these bars has a single ounce of .9999 pure gold in it. This has made this bar both incredibly attractive for collectors as well as investors. Collectors will value the ornamental style and the fact that the lunar calendar will not cycle to the horse for over a decade. The investors will see that there is high quality gold in each one of these bars that can be used as a means to stave off the market variances while storing money in a safe and liquid currency. This bar can work for anyone that has an interest in gold.
At Bullion Trading LLC, we proudly offer the 1 oz PAMP Suisse Lady Fortuna Gold Bar. As a trusted source of precious metals, we ensure that each bar is authentic and comes with its own assay card, guaranteeing its weight and purity. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to own this iconic gold bar and embrace the spirit of fortune.
Design Of the 1oz PAMP Suisse Lady Of Justice Gold Bar
The obverse of the PAMP Suisse Gold Lady of Justice Bar features a depiction of the allegorical figure with Art Deco design elements in the background. The Lady of Justice traditionally carries three primary symbols that convey the principles of fair judgment. The scales represent the weighing of evidence and the balance required in legal decisions. The sword symbolizes the power and authority of justice, suggesting that verdicts carry consequences and enforcement. The blindfold, added in the 16th century, represents impartiality and the ideal that justice should be rendered without regard to wealth, power, or other external factors.
On the reverse of the 1 oz Gold Lady of Justice Bar, you’ll find the PAMP Suisse logo and the identifying hallmarks of the bar. All design elements on this side are arranged vertically in portrait orientation, with Art Deco design themes in the background. This side of the bar also includes an individual serial number
